Gilbert Sunday Funday Ride

Gilbert, AZ

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Gilbert Sunday Funday Ride is a road and e-bike group ride in Gilbert, AZ. It meets every Sunday, meet 5:45 am, roll 6:00 am, starting at Global Bikes & E-Bikes Gilbert. Expect about 10–15 miles, no-drop, 11–13 mph.

About the Gilbert Sunday Funday Ride group ride

A short, medium-paced Sunday ride from the Gilbert shop. Regular bikes and e-bikes both welcome. The shop says plainly: 'we won't leave you behind.' Good first group ride.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
